description.invocation: One complete batch=32 offline inference call: infer(model, pixels) in resnet_inference.py:14-16, i.e. model(pixel_values=pixels).logits under @torch.inference_mode() on the FP32 CUDA model with pixels = images[torch.arange(32, device='cuda') % 3].contiguous() built once from assets pixels.npy (resnet_inference.py:29). Model loading, image preprocessing, host->device input transfer, reference construction, quality checks, warmup/repeats, peak-memory sampling, profiling and result writing are excluded.
notes: Command provenance (intent.json): python resnet_inference.py --assets /root/autodl-tmp/dev/v6-work/validation-assets/resnet18 --output /tmp/original-resnet. No --warmup/--repeats/--profile overrides, so common.py defaults warmup=2, repeats=5 apply and --profile diagnostics are not part of this run.

Measured invocation is a single complete forward of the whole ResNet-18 on the fixed GPU-resident batch=32 tensor; the surrounding reference run, close_check/negative_check, torch.save of reference tensors, warmup loop, repeat sampling loop, peak-memory stat collection and profile_once/report writing in resnet_inference.py:30-55 are the project's benchmark harness, not the repeated unit of work.

latency_ms is the per-batch-call latency at fixed batch=32 (perf_counter_ns around infer with torch.cuda.synchronize at both boundaries, resnet_inference.py:42-47). images_per_second = batch*1e9/elapsed is its exact reciprocal at fixed batch and is not an independent objective here (README.md:43,61).

Discrete exact comparison: require_exact_top1 means torch.equal(actual.argmax(-1), reference.argmax(-1)) over the full 1000-class logits (resnet_inference.py:33); integer top-1 labels must match exactly, not within tolerance.

The offline row's images_per_second_min_baseline_ratio=0.95 constraint in workloads.json belongs to that row's memory goal (peak_allocated_bytes), not to this latency objective; no performance constraint is attached to latency_ms.

Precision policy preserved: FP32 weights via from_pretrained(..., dtype=torch.float32) (resnet_inference.py:23); common.configure() sets TF32 off for matmul and cudnn, cudnn.benchmark=False, float32_matmul_precision 'highest' (common.py:34-42).
batch=32 input cycles the 3 preprocessed fixture images: pixels shape (3,3,224,224) float32, indexed by torch.arange(32, device='cuda') % 3 then .contiguous() (resnet_inference.py:29).

Source quality checks to preserve: torch.testing.assert_close on full logits with atol=rtol=1e-4 (close_check), negative control rejecting reference+1 corruption (negative_check), exact top-1 equality, and reference tensor file {workload_id}-reference.pt saved to the output dir (common.py:74-84, resnet_inference.py:31-36).
